lesson.title: Wonder as Practice
lesson.topic: Developing the habit of curiosity and inquiry to foster continuous learning and growth.
lesson.steelman: How can we cultivate a mindset that treats wonder not just as an emotion but as a deliberate practice for personal development?
lesson.example: Using the example of Albert Einstein's lifelong fascination with the nature of reality, showing how sustained wonder led to groundbreaking discoveries.

rationale: Encourages learners to see wonder not just as a passive state but an active practice for intellectual and personal growth.
